name: use-dialog-promise
description: useDialogPromise<D, V>(): state and promise for a dialog you render yourself. `open(data)` opens it and returns a promise of a `DialogResult<V>` — `{ status: "confirmed", value }`, `{ status: "cancelled" }` or `{ status: "dismissed" }` (Escape, outside click, a new open or unmount) — that never rejects. Spread `dialogProps` (`isOpen`/`onOpenChange`) on any overlay (`AlertDialog`, `Dialog`, `Sheet`) and call `confirm(value)` or `cancel()` from it. `confirm(async () => value)` keeps the dialog open with `isPending` until it resolves, and open with `error` if it throws. `data` holds what `open` passed (kept after closing for exit animations), so the dialog can be its own component that receives the controller.
